notes.title: Devlog #1 – Cards Incoming! Prepare for chaos on the golf course
notes.content: [p][b]Hey Golfers![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Just wanted to drop a quick update on [i]Grizzly Golfers[/i] — I’m working on a new mechanic that’s going to shake up the courses.[/p][p][/p][p]Introducing... [b]Cards![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592210/612531a9d600f776e62f5ed01f0c2cc003fbab27.png"][/img][/p][p]Here’s what’s planned so far:[/p][list][*][p][b]Mines[/b] – Watch your step![/p][/*][*][p][b]Easy Holes[/b] – Makes it easier to get your ball in the hole.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Terrain Effects[/b] – Like scattered craters and other surprises.[/p][/*][*][p]…and many more crazy ideas on the way![/p][/*][/list][p]Still tweaking these cards, so expect some changes. :)[/p][p][/p][p]Can’t wait to try them out? Hit that [b]wishlist[/b] button and get ready for some chaotic golfing with your buddies![/p][p][/p][p]Got any wild card ideas? Drop them in the comments![/p][p]– More updates soon![/p][p][/p]
